A '''xenotoxin''' was a type of [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] that was specifically developed for use against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
